scripts.encode:base64: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const filePath = process.argv[1]; if (!filePath) { console.error('Please provide a file path.'); process.exit(1); } const fileContents = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(filePath)); const encodedContents = fileContents.toString('base64'); fs.writeFileSync('encoded_p12.txt', encodedContents); console.log('.p12 file encoded in base64 and saved to encoded_p12.txt');"
